// diagnostic

E0910

`#PublishedSchema` struct made a breaking shape change (drop / type-change / add-without-default) with no migration to bridge it, or a declared migration op is nonsensical

What

`#PublishedSchema` struct made a breaking shape change (drop / type-change / add-without-default) with no migration to bridge it, or a declared migration op is nonsensical

Why

The registered sema rule applies here

Fix

Follow the guidance for E0910

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0910: tests/ui/migration_add_needs_default.stderr.

Error [E0910]: the published record `Account` added `verified`, but old data has no value for it
  --> tests/ui/migration_add_needs_default.jet:3:1
    |
  3 | #PublishedSchema struct Account {
    | ^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^^
 Why: `#PublishedSchema` records already written without this field can't be read unless there's a default to fill it in
 Fix: add `migration Account { add verified: <Type> = <default> }` to supply the value, or bump the major version
More: jet-lang.dev/e/E0910
